rationale: Independent judgment: REVISE. The packet is presented as a 'fixed candidate' for the third native CPU failure, but the in-scope source contains no fix. The failure receipt (FAILURE_RECONCILIATION.json) and author spec (AUTHOR21_SPEC.md) show the authored execution calls progress_factory(root/'diagnostic',...) at execution.py:1708, while the root adapter at item4_native_worker.py:75 still accepts only mount.name=='durable', raising NATIVE_REHEARSAL_PROGRESS_SCOPE and exiting 1. RAW_DIFF_STATS/RAW_COMMITS are empty and tests line 286 pins the worker to the unchanged hash a6e10e29, so no repair was authored. The factory contract test (tests:160-165) also never exercises the diagnostic sibling, so passing tests do not cover the broken boundary. I therefore cannot approve this as correct/complete. (Note: LATEST_IMPLEMENTATION_AND_DIRECTION.json carries an APPROVE for a different packet 76cd68b and is a prior-session reference, not this packet; its verdict does not bind this review.) Safeguards that the packet DOES preserve, and which are not findings: the diagnostic/stage1/total caps (HARD_DIAGNOSTIC_CAP, STAGE/TOTAL gates), no-automatic-retry (ALREADY_RESERVED_NO_RETRY; reconciliation no_automatic_retry true, reservation_released 0), the genuine REVISE15 assessment (global_findings_closed false, native_failure_preserved true, execution_authorized false), immutable original/failed rows, the native-PASS gate on reviewer16 (item4_diagnostic_review_runtime ACTUAL_NATIVE_EVIDENCE_REQUIRED / native.accepted), no new money, and synthetic CPU-only scope with no patients/GPU/network and no secret leakage. Direction sense (folded): the narrow Option A adapter correction plus a contract test covering both sibling paths is the shortest safe path; it must be independently APPROVED and re-verified to a real native PASS before install, with no finding closure, no new subsystem, and money escalated to the operator. Because the repair and its coverage are absent, the verdict is REVISE.
